mission.statement: Fitcheck exists to empower fashion shoppers to confidently see themselves in every garment by embedding photorealistic AI try-on directly into Shopify product pages.

breakdown.outcome: confidently see themselves in every garment before purchase
breakdown.differentiator: photorealistic AI try-on embedded directly into Shopify product pages

vision.statement: A world where no shopper hesitates at the product page — where every garment is seen on every body before purchase.

values.name: Fit truth over fit guessing
values.definition: We ground every recommendation in what the shopper's body data and the garment's specifications actually tell us. No aspirational sizing, no vague 'runs true to size' hand-waving.
values.in_practice: Fitcheck renders use actual garment measurements and user-provided body inputs. When confidence is low, we say so rather than fabricate certainty.

values.name: Merchant-first speed
values.definition: We ship for the Shopify merchant who needs something working today, not a roadmap promise. Setup must feel like installing a Shopify app, not a consulting engagement.
values.in_practice: Guided onboarding completes in under 30 minutes. Every feature is measured against the question: does a solo founder with 50 orders a month get value from this by end of week?

values.name: Body realism, not body idealism
values.definition: We render real bodies accurately and respectfully. Representation is a product requirement, not a marketing afterthought.
values.in_practice: Our try-on models work across body types, skin tones, and proportions without defaulting to a single aspirational silhouette. We test rendering fidelity across diverse body profiles before shipping.

values.name: Pragmatic precision
values.definition: We optimize for the confidence decision, not for pixel-perfect simulation. The shopper needs to know if the garment fits — not count every thread.
values.in_practice: We ship accuracy improvements that move conversion metrics, not rendering features that sound impressive but don't change purchase behavior.

personality.archetype_rationale: Fitcheck earns trust through knowledge — it understands garment fit better than the shopper can from a flat photo. The brand guides, informs, and empowers rather than entertains or sells.
personality.secondary_rationale: The AI try-on experience is inherently transformative — it turns a static product page into a personal fitting room. The Magician archetype captures the 'how did they do that' delight of seeing yourself in a garment you haven't tried on.

if_a_person.occupation: Fashion technologist and AI product designer
if_a_person.communication_style: Direct, evidence-backed, but warm. Explains the 'why' behind recommendations without jargon. Never condescending — respects the shopper's own body knowledge and the merchant's business instincts.
